raw <- readxl::read_excel(input$file$datapath)
raw <- raw |>
  dplyr::rename_with(trimws) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      where(is.character),
      trimws
    )
  )

author_tbl <- raw |>
  dplyr::select(AU) |>
  tidyr::separate_rows(AU, sep = ";") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    AU = stringr::str_squish(AU)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(AU != """)

summary_tbl <- author_tbl |>
  dplyr::count(AU, sort = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    entity = AU,
    n = n
  )
summary_tbl <- add_h_index(summary_tbl)
summary_tbl <- add_aac(summary_tbl)
